about: The one curated source for where the Tear program stands. docs/POSITION.md is rendered from this file by `pnpm position:render`, and `pnpm check:docs` fails when the rendered file is stale or was edited by hand. Each area records its state in a few words, what is true now, the next step, what only the owner can do, and evidence: repository paths that exist, or links to pull requests. Change this file in the same pull request that changes an area's state, update `curated` when you review the whole file, and re-render.

areas.name: Verdant Sanctum visuals
areas.summary: The game draws Verdant itself at load from a stage art recipe (src/presentation/stage-art): a key light, an atmosphere, colour ramps and layers of shared strokes (foliage, trunks, ruined arcades, water, light), painted in short slices into layers the scene renderer composes. The painted image package is gone. Any biome reaches the same look with a recipe; Pale Traverse is next. Boss warnings and strikes on Verdant are drawn as roots and thorns rising from the floor, from a table on the stage's presentation definition that any biome can supply. The stage also moves, from a `live` list in the same recipe: water rows that ripple and glint, drifting pollen, vines that sway and light shafts that fade in and out, all bounded by limits and by a measured ceiling in config/stage-readability.json, and all held still by reduced motion and low graphics.
areas.next: The owner judges the moving stage; then Pale Traverse from a recipe, with its own live list.
areas.owner_action: Judge the drawn look against the reference illustration: the owner's taste decides visual work.

areas.name: Verdant Sanctum gameplay
areas.summary: The Rootbound boss is rebuilt in all three phases as data on a shared boss move layer that Pale and later bosses reuse: Phase I's moves, Phase II's Grafts, Root Cage and Bloom Wells, and Phase III's Regrowth and Last Spring. Its body no longer hurts on touch: it blocks, and it does not play a move the player could not walk out of. The stage's Bloom Wells stand on the floor and lift the player and light enemies; who a stage field moves is one data row. The Rootbinder is rebuilt as a support that backs away, plants and roots the allies near it, so they cannot be flung or lifted until the root is cut; cutting every root or one heavy hit uproots it, and it takes more damage while planted. Its old leash on the player is replaced by a warned snare: a ring marked on the ground that holds a player who stays in it, with a cut, a 2 second release and an immunity afterwards. Verdant's nine waves are written: each has listed enemies in spawn order (wave 32 two ground allies and then a Rootbinder, 33 a Mender, 36 a Chimera, 38 a second Rootbinder late) and the pool fills the rest; any stage can carry such a table. Listed enemies arrive without affixes. The waves were measured with the playtest tool on 24 seeds: nothing justified a change to their size or health.
areas.next: Close Verdant: the owner plays the waves and the Rootbinder; then Pale.
areas.owner_action: Playtest the Rootbound in all three phases.

areas.name: Pale Traverse rework
areas.summary: Pale Traverse stays a Playground preview and is not published. Its gameplay is being rebuilt the way Verdant's was. The audit found that the Aurora Tracks touch nobody standing on a platform or the floor, the White Hart gives no warning the game can check and plays the same fight on every seed, and none of Pale uses the shared layers. The plan is eight pull requests: the tracks, the Rimehound, routes in the boss move layer, the White Hart one phase at a time, the waves, then leftovers. The earlier work on the unmerged branch codex/pale-traverse-r4 is reference only.
areas.next: Slice 1: rebuild the Aurora Tracks as roads on a surface that raise top speed.

areas.name: Playtest tool
areas.state: Stage 2 under way: stage 1 is done (pnpm playtest bosses and sweep); pnpm playtest waves opens any Adventure wave directly, runs plays whole runs from wave 1, enemies meets each enemy kind alone, and coverage lists what the game defines that no report brought into play
areas.summary: One command, pnpm playtest, that plays the game headless with scripted players on fixed seeds and reports clear rates, time to kill, damage taken and differences between builds. It is built from the working parts of TearBench and the scripted player and replaces both names. Verified on 2026-11-16: the scripted player runs headless at 13 to 15 times real time and the same seed reproduces exactly.

areas.name: Replays
areas.state: In progress: PR 1, PR 2 and PR 2b merged (hidden replay features, replay extras and REPAIR removed); PR 3 open (snapshot codecs to src/gameplay/snapshot)
areas.summary: Players reach two replay systems today: Ghost 2 (position samples in localStorage, used by the REPLAYS tab, the feed and leaderboard links) and the Ghost V3 capsules (re-simulated, in IndexedDB, used by VAULT, CAREER and the Theater). The plan replaces both with one versioned record and five plain modules (record, store, watch, share, verify), moves the replay world and snapshot codecs out of TearBench, and deletes src/ghost (118 replay modules and about 800,000 characters today).
areas.next: Merge PR 3, then PR 4 (the detached world moves to src/app/world/detached).

areas.name: Cinematics
areas.state: Plan approved by the lead; blocking-removal slices starting; look board waiting for the owner
areas.summary: Boss phase changes stop the fight today: a ritual script freezes the combat step, locks the player and waits for a tap or a reading timeout (5.1-6.8 s each; the Source descent 11.5 s; Rootbound stands still for 12.9 s of a 32-37 s fight). Chapter openings take 25-39 s at Full. The plan makes every in-fight beat a boss move with at most a banner, cuts chapter openings and the finale to short cards that never wait, replaces the cinematic director and ritual layer with one stage beat, and adds a rule over every boss that no tick blocks input or the combat step.
areas.next: PR 1: the rule over every boss and no slow motion; then the rituals come out boss by boss (PRs 2-4). The banner, chapter card and epilogue (PRs 6-8) wait for the owner’s verdict on the look board.
areas.owner_action: Approve or correct the look board on the ledger.

Sessions write anything mobile will need later in plans/MOBILE_LATER.md.
